message.content: The film most frequently cited as the standout of 2020 is **“Parasite”** (2019‑release). Directed by Bong Joon‑ho, it won the Academy Award for Best Picture, becoming the first non‑English‑language film to do so. Critics praised its sharp social commentary, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction, making it the consensus “best movie” of that year.
